newsitem.title: USA: Titan spins off major stake in Internet unit.
newsitem.headline: Titan spins off major stake in Internet unit.

text.p: Titan Corp said Monday it had spun off a majority interest in its ServNOW! subsidiary to a group of venture capital investors in exchange for a $4.2 million investment in the Internet software business.
Titan said it will retain a minority equity interest in ServNOW! in exchange for contributed technology and intellectual property.
ServNOW! NetTechnologies Inc is a start-up venture based largely on Titan's defense information systems capabilities, the company said.
The product line targets Web-based management and delivery for information providers, corporate intranets and Internet service providers.
